verdicts.reason: Both are unusable. The forest background is a narrow centred strip and does not fill the banner, so the white headline 'Special Event Devoted to International Day of Forests' and the subhead disappear into the white canvas on both sides. Only fragments like 'nternat', 'of For' and 'n & Forest cl' can be read, and the quote and URL are lost entirely. A is marginally less broken because 'March 21' at least sits framed between its two cream rules, though it is pale cream on white. In B, 'March 21' is smaller and one rule is stranded alone on the far right, which leaves even less structure.
